channel.title: Blockfront
channel.description: Blockfront reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, regulation, security incidents, funding rounds and network upgrades.

item.title: ETH for Base gas: exchange withdrawals and bridges
item.description: To get ETH for gas on Base, withdraw it directly from Coinbase or bridge ETH from Ethereum; keep a balance on Base before moving USDC or signing transactions.

item.title: What is a gas fee in crypto swaps: Read the network charge
item.description: A gas fee in crypto swaps is the network charge for processing your transaction, paid in the chain’s native token and separate from the tokens you trade.

item.title: EU proposes crypto crackdown in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd sanctions package would cut 60 Russian banks from SWIFT and expand crypto enforcement, including against third-country networks aiding evasion.

item.title: How to use the Berachain bridge with MetaMask and see funds arrive
item.description: How to use the Berachain bridge with MetaMask: approve the ERC-20, submit the bridge transaction, then track its source hash until funds appear on Berachain.

item.title: Jupiter verified tokens: identity versus safety
item.description: A Jupiter verified token does not mean it is safe to buy. The badge helps confirm the token and mint; check on-chain controls, liquidity and holders separately.

item.title: Flash loan vs own capital: fund a DEX gap with the right route
item.description: Flash loan vs own capital for an arbitrage trade: borrow for a gap larger than your balance; use your funds for small trades you can execute from a wallet.

item.title: Ukraine passes crypto law with 15 billion hryvnia revenue estimate
item.description: Ukraine’s parliament approved a crypto market and tax framework, projecting up to 15 billion hryvnias in revenue; the law is due to take effect in July 2027.

item.title: Jupiter token verification: how a mint earns its tag
item.description: How Jupiter token verification works: Jupiter checks a submitted Solana mint’s identity, metadata and trading activity before adding its address to the verified list.

item.title: How Was Bitcoin Held for renBTC? Shared Control
item.description: How was Bitcoin held for renBTC? RenVM kept BTC at gateway addresses controlled by Darknodes’ shared signing key, then authorized renBTC minting on Ethereum.

item.title: Bookmark or search result: safer crypto-site access
item.description: For a first-time crypto visitor, a verified browser bookmark is safer than choosing a Google Search result each time. A bookmark stores one exact URL and…

item.title: How to reset a stuck nonce in MetaMask’s queue
item.description: How to reset a stuck nonce in MetaMask: replace the pending transaction at the same nonce with a higher fee so later transactions can leave the queue.

item.title: US moves to forfeit $1.1 billion from Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department filed to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to Binance’s October hack, as US-led efforts have frozen, seized or returned $2.9 billion.

item.title: Insufficient-funds-for-gas errors: Why tokens cannot pay fees
item.description: An insufficient funds for gas error can appear while your wallet holds tokens: fees require native ETH on Ethereum or SUI on Sui, on the transaction’s network.

item.title: EU proposes crypto curbs in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission proposed its 22nd Russia sanctions package, including crypto and payment-network measures, as the plan awaits approval by all 27 EU states.

item.title: US seeks forfeiture of Binance hack funds after $1.2B seizure
item.description: The FBI says a court authorized action against $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion hack; a new forfeiture case covers a $1 billion USDC portion.

item.title: EU targets Russian banks and crypto in 22nd sanctions proposal
item.description: The European Commission proposed targeting 60 Russian banks and crypto networks in its 22nd sanctions package, which still needs approval from all 27 EU states.

item.title: Restaking vs Regular ETH Staking: What Changes?
item.description: Eigen layer restaking vs regular ETH staking: restaking adds possible AVS rewards, operator choice, extra slashing rules and a longer withdrawal path.

item.title: How to bridge to Monad from wallet signature to balance
item.description: Monad bridge end to end: your wallet signs a source-chain deposit; finality, attestation and relaying deliver minted or unlocked tokens to your destination balance.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, part of a wider $2.7 billion freeze as recovery work continues.

item.title: Tether backs SCRYPT’s expansion into institutional payments
item.description: Tether announced a strategic investment in Swiss stablecoin provider SCRYPT on Nov. 19, backing its move into fiat accounts and third-party payments for institutions.
